carried_set_rule: One estimator is judged: the hybrid named in carried_models (T2's range with the frozen -g1 fused tracker's course and speed, theta 180), with T2 bound by model_digests and the hybrid tied to its two input files by tma-g5's prediction chain. G8 (Annex C §C.15, §C.17): G5's five gated checks against the -g1 IMM, and g8-range-vs-network against beat_estimator, each at 97.5% with a scenario-clustered bootstrap; pass if all six pass, fail if any fails, otherwise inconclusive, with one re-score on seed 225 (1,100,000; 110,000-scenario test split).
change: Phase 10 (SRD Annex C §C.17, owner decisions 2026-11-12): judge the hybrid of the frozen T2's range with the frozen -g1 fused tracker's velocity under realistic bearing error (generator 0.6.0, configs/phase7-ranges.json) at G8, with the fused tracker as the estimator to beat on range. Nothing is trained or tuned.
rationale: On seed 217 validation (tma-g5 --beat diagnostic, experiments/20261112-p10-val): hybrid/IMM overall range 0.730, course 0.906; settled range 0.787, course 0.865, speed 0.887; hybrid/fused range 0.940 [0.912, 0.969]; every point and interval within its limit (the carry rule). Forecast before scoring: P(G8 pass on seed 224) about 95%; the weakest check is hybrid/fused range (upper bound 0.969 on validation).
